The Festival

Art and ecology, side by side

Colors of the Prairie brings together chalk artists, families, and nature lovers for a day of creativity rooted in the beauty of our greenspace. Held on the grounds of the Willow Waterhole Greenspace Conservancy, the festival marks our 25th anniversary with vibrant chalk murals, live music, hands-on ecology, and native plants to take home and grow.

Chalk Art Competition

Watch 30 to 40 artists transform the pavement into murals inspired by prairies and pollinators, with prizes awarded.

Native Plant Giveaway

Take home a native fruit tree, provided in partnership with the Student Conservation Association, plus plants from local growers.

Seed Ball Station

Roll your own seed ball to help pollinators thrive across Houston, one prairie patch at a time.

Live Music & Learning

Enjoy a live DJ set alongside education stations exploring our urban prairie and wetlands.

Good to Know

FAQ & directions

How much does it cost to attend?
Nothing. Colors of the Prairie is free and open to the public. Bring the whole family.
What if it rains?
Our rain date is Saturday, November 14, 2026. If we need to postpone, we will announce it here and on our social media by the morning of the event.
Where do I park?
Parking is available at 5300 Dryad Dr, Houston, TX 77035. Follow our signage and volunteer directions when you arrive.
Can I bring my dog?
Leashed, friendly dogs are welcome in general areas. Please keep pets away from the chalk squares and giveaway stations.
How do I sign up as an artist or vendor?
Applications are open now through October 1, 2026. Use the Apply as an Artist or Apply as a Vendor buttons in the Artists and Vendors section above, or reach out through the contact section below with any questions.
Will there be food?
Yes. Food and beverages will be available from our participating vendors.
Can I bring my own chalk?
Glitter and liquid chalk are not permitted, as they are difficult to clean and can harm the environment. Environmentally safe chalk will be available for purchase at the festival.
